rule: Exact recipe source with 4 servings and quantities; canonical nutrition not adopted from auto-generated publisher value.
Keep cooked/boiled rice separate from raw rice; never resolve cooked rice to raw nutrition.
Cooked rice soaked/fermented with curd/water is a prepared dish, not generic cooked rice.
Rice-only and rice+coconut recipes are separate variants.
Do not use one generic chicken nutrient record when cut/skin/preparation is known.
Do not use one generic mutton record when cut/fat/preparation is known.
Name-only/recipe-family records remain non-canonical until source quantities and nutrient mappings are complete.
Publisher-reported calories are stored separately and are not used as canonical nutrition unless source quality is appropriate.
